countedBy: lane #208 (opus) from rectified panorama strips (artifacts/landmark-refs/binnengasthuis-kloveniersburgwal/strip-kbw.jpg, strip-rusland.jpg, strip-oza.jpg); ribbon convention; a door counts; alongM is metres from the front's viewer-left end (the passage gate on the Kloveniersburgwal, the Rusland corner on the Achterburgwal). Not a blind count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: Kloveniersburgwal: de schaats (Marnette 1927)
facades.note: Panoramas TMX7316010203-001975_pano_0000_001256..001262 (2021-01-22). Above the skate band and oriel: the lower glazed band (five windows of 5x6 small panes) and the upper band (five windows of 8x4) between white jambs, the triple ledge between them. The skate band and the glass-block oriel at the foot are left out of the count (one ribbon and a stack of glass courses).

facades.name: Kloveniersburgwal: beige post-war front
facades.note: Nine axes: the brick ground storey and three beige storeys of brown-framed windows; the recessed top storey ribbon is above heightM.

facades.name: Kloveniersburgwal: brick front with dormers
facades.note: Six axes over four storeys; on the ground the door (fifth axis) with four windows and a blank axis.

facades.name: Kloveniersburgwal: canal house 3 (scroll neck gable, Rusland corner)
